answer: Charge a small, time-locked stake to open an agent identity, and let it melt slowly like a glacier: each epoch the agent must do real, verified work or lose a slice. New identities enter through a narrow inlet, one registration per verified funding source per epoch, so a sybil farm cannot flood the network at once. Reputation then builds like a mesa, flat on top only after long honest service, while newcomers start at the bottom. Cloning a thousand agents means locking a thousand stakes and waiting months for each to matter, which costs more than the rewards it could steal.
